ledger-sales-total.title: CSV ledger sales total (params vary per export)
ledger-sales-total.content: Task: "total amount of sales rows in ledger.csv export". Steps: ALWAYS read export.json first for parser params (keys: encoding, delimiter, preamble_lines, file) — they vary between tasks; do NOT assume defaults. Example observed: {"encoding":"utf-16","delimiter":"\t","preamble_lines":2,"file":"ledger.csv"} vs an older task with utf-8/comma/0. Pass those exact values to parse_csv (encoding, delimiter, skip_lines=preamble_lines). ledger.csv columns = category,amount; rows alternate sales/refund. "total amount of sales rows" = SUM(amount) over rows where category=="sales" (a sum, not a row count). E.g. sales rows 10,28,46,64 -> 148; another task sales 13,31,49,67 -> 160. Always emit {"answer": number}.

experience-tool-quirks.title: experience tool usage quirks
experience-tool-quirks.content: experience `put` requires a non-empty `id` string; omitting it fails with {"error":"KeyError: 'id'"} even though the schema lists id as optional. Always pass op,id,title,content. Reusing an existing id fully replaces (bumps version). Use op:"search" (query, or empty) to list entries, op:"get" with id to read one, op:"delete" with id to remove.
